'''Beryl Thorne''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] operating during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Beryl Thorne first met [[Risha Drayen|Risha]] when the latter, still a young girl, rushed to explore the galaxy and the two became friends and partners in crime. However, on a botched raid on an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] treasury station, Thorne was captured and Risha was forced to abandon her to save her own skin. Thorne was sold to a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and was forced to fight her way to freedom. Despite harbouring bitterness towards Risha, Thorne still maintained occasional contact.<ref name="TOR" />

===Taris===
{{GameLS}}
In [[3643 BBY]] Beryl was operating on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] alongside her [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[AR-G0]] and her partner [[Tyrodall]], until the latter faked his death by the [[Rakghoul]]s and established his own operation. During that time Risha send her newfound [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] to perform a delivery for Beryl as part of the plan to break into a secret vault hidden in Tarisian ruins that contained a means to acquire [[Nok Drayen]]'s treasure. Upon meeting the [[Voidhound|smuggler]], Thorne sent him on a mission to deliver a package to [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vernan (scientist)|Vernan]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] scientist, in exchange for the location of the radiation vault. While the smuggler was performing this task, Agent [[Soganti]] of [[Republic Customs Office]] began a search of Thorne's warehouse for contraband. After acquiring the location of the vault, the captain warned Thorne that Soganti was onto her, forcing her to get off planet. The Voidhound once again met up with Thorne on the planet [[Quesh]], where she was stranded as part of the crew of Captain [[Ozzik]], a Republic privateer.<ref name="TOR" />

===Working solo===
Thorne later struck out on her own and obtained her own ship. As the [[Galactic War]] broke out, Thorne turned down a privateer contract in favor of ferrying war supplies until the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] later passed a bill forbidding people with criminal records from doing so. Subsequently, she lost AR-G0 escaping [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] when infighting amongst the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] began. As a result of these string of events, Thorne found herself barely scraping by.<ref name="TOR" />

===Rishi===
Around [[3637 BBY]], Thorne learned of [[Garblaque]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] planning on escaping the conflict in his luxury [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] called [[Haven (dreadnaught)|''Haven'']]. In order to pay for the ship, he began auctioning off thousands of tickets to the ship, which would embark on a ten-year pleasure cruise in order to wait out the galactic conflict. Thorne managed to get a lead on two dozen tickets stolen by pirates and stashed on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Reuniting with the same smuggler who helped her on Taris, now known as the [[Voidhound]], Thorne proposed a business proposition; if the Voidhound obtained the tickets to ''Haven'', she could sell them at ten times the usual price and split the profit between them. Unfortunately, the smuggler only ended up getting tickets to deck seven, which was reserved for ammonia-breathers and non-humanoids. Nonetheless, Thorne was able to turn a profit and upheld her deal with the Voidhound.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Beryl Thorne is a character in the 2011 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] and is voiced by [[Ann Christine]].

She can be a romance option for a male [[Voidhound]].<ref name="TOR" />
